newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania average one-week rate rises to 52.64 pct.
newsitem.headline: Romania average one-week rate rises to 52.64 pct.

text.p: Romania's central bank said on Friday the average accepted rate for its one-week refinancing funds rose to 52.64 percent from last week's 52.57 percent.

The central bank's offer of 1.25 trillion lei, unchanged from the previous week, was undersubscribed, with three banks entering bids worth a total 1.16 trillion lei at prices ranging from 52 percent to 53 percent.
The central bank minimum permitted rate was 52 percent, unchanged from last week when it rose one percentage point in a move to tighten monetary policies to prop up the leu.
The leu's retail rates dipped to around 5,000 to the dollar from about 3,500 in mid-October. Its interbank rates on Friday were far firmer, at 3,600/15.
